title: Carpenter Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for carpentry work — cabinetry, trim, decking, doors, framing and materials. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 14 — payment due within 14 days. Late fee of 1.5% per month applies after the due date.
notes: Thank you for your business. Scope per the signed estimate; change orders billed separately.
features: Auto-calculating totals and tax in Excel
Pre-filled carpentry line items: cabinetry, trim, decking, doors, framing, materials
Net-14 payment terms and late-fee line standard for carpentry invoices
License # field — many states require a contractor license on client-facing invoices

faqs.q: What should I include on a carpenter invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and license number, the client and job-site address, a dated line-item list (cabinetry, trim, decking, doors, framing, materials), payment terms and due date. Reference the signed estimate for scope.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate totals automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantities and rates, and the subtotal, tax and balance due update automatically.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your contractor board and a CPA or attorney before use.
